none: PAS NLM-34582A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Chipped. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins. In exergue: PTR. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 1.37gms, die axis: 6
